method: npm run measure:scan-review, real Tesseract, identical committed raster before and after; threshold 70

ownerPhotographs.privacy: Five originals are stored only under ignored data/private. No photograph, name, phone number, birth date, hash or locating path is recorded here.
ownerPhotographs.preparation: Each original was orientation-normalized and reduced to the editor's 2600 px maximum before the real OCR run. Counts are after telephone-off, using course reference date 2026-08-08.
ownerPhotographs.result: Surname-given wins on every supplied photograph, so the question is removed on every one. Missing fields fall on every run, by 11 to 16 per capture (70 across five repeated views of the same roster).
ownerPhotographs.discrepancy: The plan's hand count said 20-0. The required reused inferSex recogniser also votes for surnames ending in a/o, so real OCR votes are not 20-0. The decision is nevertheless unanimous across the five captures. The prior 29 to 15 count was a fourteen-field overall reduction, not nineteen; measured counts replace that arithmetic rather than restating it.

decisions: Use exactly inferSex recognition, including its existing suffix rule; no new name dictionary.
A strict majority with at least two supporting rows decides one order per sheet. Otherwise ask.
A remembered explicit choice takes precedence; a deduction itself is not remembered as if it were a human answer.
Ambiguous compound splits retain their current visible text and their unresolved review gate. No previously shown field is blanked.
